notes.title: Summer Spectacular 2019!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4314528/3463e3426efd42ef6973f3953c38f91b332f80e1.jpg[/img]

[b]Summer Spectacular![/b]

Summer is here, the days are long, and that means it's time to celebrate. Start your July off right with in-game bonuses, member gifts, and deals! Everything begins July 1, 2019: 
 
[list]
[*][b]Bonus Rewards![/b]
[list]
[*]All XP, faction, and rare spawns will be increased by 76%.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*][b]Member Gifts![/b]
[list]
[*]Log in to claim your two timely and celebratory familiars: the Metamorph Totem: Murikaglider and the Metamorph Totem: Cernerder'Eh Murkglider. Look for these in your reward window once you log in. Members only.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*][b]Heritage Crates Return![/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you check out the Marketplace, because the spectacular is a special opportunity to catch up on any of the Heritage Crates you might have missed. ALL Heritage Crates are back in the Marketplace throughout the event.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

The Summer Spectacular begins at 12PM PT (noon) on July 1, 2019, and ends at 12PM PT (noon) on July 8, 2019.

notes.title: New Expansion: The Burning Lands
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4314528/64651cebe16603bcf10de3f6924480940f589647.jpg[/img]

 
Hail, brave heroes of Norrath, and brace yourselves!

The longstanding peace between the jann is over, and war has broken out between the djinn from the Plane of Air and the efreeti from the Plane of Fire! 

What has sparked this dispute and who will emerge victorious? Will you survive the Trials of Smoke and help end this conflict? It is finally time to head back to the Planes and unravel the mysteries that await you there! 

[h1][b][url=https://www.everquest.com/expansion-content]EverQuest's 25th expansion, The Burning Lands, is available now![/url][/b][/h1]

https://youtu.be/OSvyzU5h6I0

Want a more in-depth look at the new lands you'll be exploring? Take a moment to review our preview articles before diving into the new expansion content:
[list][*][b][url=https://www.everquest.com/news/eq-the-burning-lands-expansion-features-2018]The Burning Lands Expansion Overview[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.everquest.com/news/eq-the-burning-lands-aalishai-preview-2018]Aalishai[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.everquest.com/news/eq-the-burning-lands-esianti-preview-2018]Esianti[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.everquest.com/news/eq-the-burning-mearatas-preview-2018]Mearatas[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.everquest.com/news/eq-the-burning-lands-trials-of-smoke-preview-2018]Trials of Smoke[/url][/b][/*][/list]
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4314528/d54ee3f75d14c29626a4d86d3e4af5dea6113b55.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4314528/de76cae6834959fba6c7ef0f2cf995d47f569697.jpg[/img]

If you're looking to read up on the turmoil that is descending upon the Elemental Planes, you can [b][url=https://www.everquest.com/expansion-content]visit the Burning Lands expansion page to learn more[/url][/b]! 

Plus, if you're an All Access Member, you'll also recieve an additional 10% off of the expansion and more! [url=https://www.everquest2.com/membership][b]You can learn more about All Access perks here[/b].[/url]

 

We'll see you in the Planes!
